1. Open the **Compass** app (built-in)
2. Allow location access if prompted
3. Your coordinates will appear at the bottom of the screen

### Android:
1. Open **Google Maps**
2. Tap the blue dot (your location)
3. Your coordinates will appear at the top

## **If you're on a computer:**

### Using Google Maps (easiest):
1. Go to [google.com/maps](https://google.com/maps)
2. Allow location access when prompted
3. Click the blue "locate me" button (circular target icon in the lower right)
4. Right-click on the blue dot that appears
5. Click the coordinates at the top of the menu (they'll be copied)
